forms_note: Forms default to proteus.sweep.DEFAULT_FORMS = '8-K,SC TO-I,SC TO-C' (set a 'forms' key here to override). 8-K alone was blind to the schedule a capital return COMMENCES on: ABUS announced its Dutch auction in an 8-K (caught 2026-08-21) but commenced on an SC TO-I (2026-08-24) the sweep never saw. Widened 2026-08-24; the same run surfaced SQFT's SC TO-I/A, a hit 8-K-only could not produce.
kill_classes: special dividends without a mispriced stub (grinder class)
NEW merger agreements (that is merger-arb / Hermes craft, not post-resolution repricing)
proxy/vote boilerplate phrase matches (check the Item number)
employee stock-option EXCHANGE offers filed as SC TO-I (13e-4 repricing of underwater options; cover's Title of Class = 'Options to Purchase Common Stock' - no holder cash; RXST 8/25)
BDC/interval-fund NAV repurchase offers (recurring TO-I family; the fam flags, the class kills)
covered mega-cap/utility capital-return boilerplate ($10B+, priced same-day - no neglect)
investor-deck/chart phrase matches (fam fires on HISTORICAL dividend/buyback charts, not new declarations; JBSS 8/25)
name: resolved_event_sweep
purpose: Post-resolution repricing hunt: EDGAR FTS over fresh 8-Ks AND tender schedules (SC TO-I/SC TO-C, amendments included) for resolution + capital-return language. Window = prior session day through today (FTS indexing lags; always re-cover).
survivor_bar: resolved uncertainty + balance-sheet-backed capital return or forced repricing, tape not yet moved; ABUS 8/13 is the archetype
